announcements.text: Xtremis Inc.,* Washington, D.C., was awarded a firm-fixed-price contract for research and development of AI and machine learning methods for the detection of UAS. Work will be performed in West Fork, Arkansas, with an estimated completion date of Oct. 30, 2029. Army Contracting Command, Aberdeen Proving Ground, Maryland, is the contracting activity (W911QX-26-C-A019). (Awarded July 15, 2026).

announcements.text: Rockwell Collins Inc., Cedar Rapids, Iowa, is awarded $82,040,906 for a firm-fixed-price contract (N00383-26-D-0014) to provide logistics, repair and spare support for the AN/ARC-210(V) radio system – to include iterations GEN5 and GEN6. The five-year contract includes no option provisions. Work performed under this contract will only be in response to awarded delivery orders and all work will be completed in Cedar Rapids, Iowa, by July 2031. At the time of award, no Foreign Military Sales (FMS) are involved, however standard cooperative logistics supply support arrangement language is included in the contract as a contingency measure in case future FMS requirements arise that were not originally forecast. Fiscal 2026 working capital funds (Navy) in the amount of $16,408,181 will be obligated at the time of award to fund delivery order N00383-26-F-0001 and those funds do not expire. Subsequent delivery orders under the resultant contract will be funded with appropriate fiscal working capital funds (Navy). One company was solicited for this sole-source requirement pursuant to the authority set forth in 10 U.S. Code 3204 (a)(1) with one offer received. Naval Supply Systems Command Weapon Systems Support, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, is the contracting activity.

announcements.text: L3 Technologies Inc., was awarded a $22,600,376 maximum ceiling, requirements indefinite-delivery contract for the Multifunctional Information Distribution System Low Volume Terminal and Joint Tactical Radio System. This contract provides for the repair of MIDS LVT and JTRS equipment. Work will be performed at Salt Lake City, Utah, and is expected to be completed by August 2, 2031. This contract involves Foreign Military Sales to various countries. This contract was a sole source acquisition. No funds are being obligated at time of award. The Air Force Life Cycle Management Center, Cryptologic and Cyber Systems Division, San Antonio, Texas, is the contracting activity (FA8307-26-D-B001). (Awarded on August 3, 2026).
